strings.notes: 基博 not in 0719; US contact Bird Keeper Vance (US 0696)

strings.zh: 你真的好强啊！{SCROLL}但是我也不甘心啊⋯⋯{SCROLL}对了！把你的电话号码{NEWLINE}告诉我吧！{CLEAR}我们以后再来对战！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: You are sure strong. But I don’t{NEWLINE}want to just slink away...{SCROLL}I know! Could I get your number?{NEWLINE}Let’s meet up for more battles!{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 那我下次约你的话,{NEWLINE}你一定要来啊！
strings.en: Don’t forget to come and see me{NEWLINE}when I challenge you!

strings.zh: 你不认为多一个{NEWLINE}驱鸟使的朋友很好吗？{SCROLL}好好想想吧。
strings.en: A Bird Keeper friend isn’t a bad thing to{NEWLINE}have, I’d say...{SCROLL}Won’t you reconsider?

strings.zh: 与优秀训练是对战,{NEWLINE}我求之不得！{SCROLL}要是你乐意的话,{NEWLINE}把你的电话号码给我吧！{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: I want to battle tough Trainers as{NEWLINE}often as I can!{SCROLL}If you’re up for it,{NEWLINE}could I get your number?{VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0696/4 | RV073: addition: dropped added 'meet up for more battles'; restored 要是你乐意的话; layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: 你真的好强啊！{SCROLL}从和你这么多场的对战中,{NEWLINE}我受益匪浅⋯⋯{SCROLL}对了！{NEWLINE}这个就当是谢礼送你吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: You are really, really strong!{SCROLL}Thanks for taking me on so often--{NEWLINE}I learned a whole lot from you.{SCROLL}I know! This will do as my thanks!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你就在附近吧？{SCROLL}那直接来和我说话就行了吧？
strings.en: You’re nearby, aren’t you?{SCROLL}Why not come and talk in person?

strings.zh: 说起我的{VAR:0100:10},{NEWLINE}又比以前厉害了不少,{CLEAR}简直就是气势如虹！{SCROLL}{VAR:0100:11}之流{NEWLINE}很轻松就能搞定！{SCROLL}⋯⋯哎？你也是？{NEWLINE}啊哈哈,那就恭喜你了。{SCROLL}拜拜！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10}’s become tougher.{NEWLINE}We’ve achieved liftoff!{SCROLL}We can easily beat {VAR:0100:11}!{SCROLL}...Huh? You, too? Isn’t that great?{NEWLINE}Let’s talk later!

strings.zh: 说起我的{VAR:0100:10},{NEWLINE}又比以前厉害了不少,{CLEAR}简直就是气势如虹！{SCROLL}不过还是让{NEWLINE}{VAR:0100:11}逃走了⋯⋯{CLEAR}我还在犹豫要不要去追它。{SCROLL}拜拜！
strings.en: My {VAR:0100:10}’s gotten a lot tougher{NEWLINE}than before. We’ve achieved liftoff!{SCROLL}But a {VAR:0100:11} still got away{NEWLINE}from us... I’m still deciding{CLEAR}whether to chase after it.{SCROLL}Let’s talk later!

strings.zh: 我现在在{VAR:0104:3}！{NEWLINE}这里是和你{CLEAR}初次见面的地方！{SCROLL}再和我来场对战吧？{NEWLINE}我会在这里待一段时间的！
strings.en: Right now, I’m on {VAR:0104:3}.{NEWLINE}You know--where I first met you?{SCROLL}Want to battle? I’ll wait here.

strings.zh: 喂,{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}快点快点！{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}！{NEWLINE}快点飞过来！
喂,{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}快点快点！{SCROLL}我在{VAR:0104:3}！{NEWLINE}快点飞过来！
我很期待下一次的对战！
strings.en: I’ll be looking forward to our{NEWLINE}next battle!
